## Introduction

This is where I will conduct my analyses

## Descriptive Statistics

Perhaps some descriptive statistics would be useful here.

```{r}
source("R/libraries.R")
source("R/functions.R")
load("data/validation_final.Rdata")

df |>
    group_by(sex_factor) |>
    summarize(mean(job_knowledge_total))
```

## Inferential Statistics

Some simple statistics are presented below to evaluate the data.

```{r}
t.test(job_knowledge_total ~ sex_factor, data = df)
```
